$comment: Deploy na VPS com o vps-deployer: deployer deploy compose <esta pasta>. Sobe API + landing, publica os domínios no Caddy e dispara o build do app (Windows, Linux, Android) em segundo plano.
name: memorycard

healthcheck.cmd: docker exec memorycard-api wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health && docker exec memorycard-api wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:8000/ | grep -q '<html'

domains.note: bloco manual no Caddyfile: site estático do memorycardcloud-fe-be (/var/www/memorycard.cloud) + /api/* para a API

post_deploy.name: apps
post_deploy.description: Build do app para Windows, Linux e Android (macOS/iOS: num Mac) e publicação em /baixar
post_deploy.run: export HOST_UID=$(id -u) HOST_GID=$(id -g); docker compose -p memorycard -f docker-compose.vps.yml --profile apps build app-builder && docker compose -p memorycard -f docker-compose.vps.yml --profile apps run --rm -T --no-deps app-builder
